fusions.name: Focused Beam
fusions.desc: Fires a beam that deals 36 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its resistances. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Fanned Glare
fusions.desc: Fans a narrow beam 5 tiles ahead that deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Exposed] for 6 seconds, its elemental resistances lowered. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Narrowed Mind
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Glow
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
